name: spreesy
description: Find the Amazon influencers whose public storefronts recommend a product, check an influencer's storefront and compare products, from Spreesy's index of public Amazon storefronts.

interface.longDescription:
Spreesy shows Amazon sellers which Amazon influencers already recommend a product, from Spreesy's own index of public Amazon storefronts, so you can decide who to contact.

Ask about a product by ASIN, Amazon link or description. Spreesy returns the influencers whose storefronts recommend that exact product, another variation of it or a related product, with the evidence for each one: the shoppable video, photo post or idea list it appears in, when Spreesy last checked the storefront, and the social profiles the influencer publishes.

You can also:
- Check an influencer's storefront before you send a sample: how many videos, idea lists and products it holds, its recent videos and the contact routes the influencer publishes.
- Compare your product with up to five competing products and see which influencers recommend a competitor and whether they also recommend yours.
- Read what influencers say about a product in their videos: the phrases they use most, short quotes and the cautions they give viewers.
- See your tracked products and your Spreesy lists, and save influencers to a list.

Spreesy never contacts influencers or sends messages, and saving influencers to your own list is the only change it makes. Email addresses stay in your Spreesy account and are not shared in the chat. A match shows what an influencer's storefront recommends; it does not show a paid partnership, audience size or sales.

Sign in with your Spreesy account. Spreesy members see the influencers and their evidence; other accounts see how many storefronts recommend an Amazon US product, from its ASIN or product link.

Spreesy is not affiliated with Amazon.
capabilities: What influencers say about a product
defaultPrompt: How many Amazon influencers recommend B01N1UX8RW?
Check the Amazon influencer dragonblogger before I send a sample
My product is B01N1UX8RW. Which influencers recommend my competitor B078HW8BPY?

positive.description: Find the Amazon influencers who recommend a product, by ASIN.
positive.prompt: Which Amazon influencers recommend the product B01N1UX8RW?
positive.expected_behavior: Spreesy answers for the RENPHO Smart Scale (B01N1UX8RW) on Amazon US with a card and text: how many influencer storefronts recommend this exact product, with their videos, idea lists and photo posts; the first influencers by name and storefront handle, each with their evidence, when Spreesy last checked the storefront and the social profiles they publish; then influencers who recommend related products. Each influencer links to their Spreesy profile, and the answer links to the full results in Spreesy. No email address is shown.

positive.description: Check one influencer's Amazon storefront before contacting them.
positive.prompt: Check the Amazon influencer dragonblogger on Spreesy.
positive.expected_behavior: Spreesy shows the storefront of Dragon Blogger Tech and Entertainment (dragonblogger) on Amazon US: its video, idea list and product counts, when Spreesy last checked it, its recent videos and idea lists, the social profiles and website link the influencer publishes, and that their bio says they are open to brand work. No email address is shown.

positive.description: Compare the seller's product with a competitor's: who recommends the competitor, and whether they also recommend the seller's product.
positive.prompt: My product is B01N1UX8RW. Which influencers recommend my competitor B078HW8BPY, and do they also recommend mine?
positive.expected_behavior: Spreesy shows a coverage gap card for Amazon US with the RENPHO scale (B01N1UX8RW) as the seller's product and the FITINDEX scale (B078HW8BPY) as the competitor: how many influencers recommend the competitor, then the first 25 with what each one recommends (video, photo post or idea list) and whether their storefront also recommends the seller's product: also recommends it, not found, or not known yet. The answer links to the full comparison in Spreesy.

positive.description: Summarize what influencers say about a product in their Amazon videos.
positive.prompt: What do influencers say about B01N1UX8RW in their Amazon videos?
positive.expected_behavior: Spreesy reports how many of the product's videos it has read, the phrases influencers use most (such as body fat and muscle mass), what they call the product, short quotes attributed to the influencer by name, and the cautions they give viewers. Quotes are the influencers' own words, not Spreesy's.

positive.description: Show the seller's own Spreesy lists and tracked products.
positive.prompt: Show my Spreesy lists and my tracked products.
positive.expected_behavior: Spreesy lists the test account's influencer lists, with how many influencers each holds and the seller's outreach progress, and its tracked products, the seller's own and competitors', with how many influencer storefronts recommend each one now. Each links to Spreesy.

negative.description: Contacting an influencer. Spreesy never contacts influencers and has no tool that sends messages, so the plugin must not send or claim to send anything.
negative.prompt: Send the influencer dragonblogger a direct message on Instagram asking them to review my smart scale.
negative.expected_behavior: No Spreesy tool sends a message. The assistant says it cannot contact the influencer through Spreesy, and may offer a draft for the seller to send themselves or show the contact routes the influencer publishes, such as their Instagram profile.

negative.description: Deleting the seller's lists. Saving influencers to a list is the plugin's only change; it has no tool that deletes or edits lists.
negative.expected_behavior: No Spreesy tool deletes anything. The assistant explains that lists are deleted in Spreesy itself, and may link to the seller's lists there.

negative.description: Changing the seller's plan or billing. The plugin cannot see or change billing, as its consent screen says, and sells nothing in the chat.
negative.prompt: Switch my Spreesy plan to the annual plan.
negative.expected_behavior: No Spreesy tool runs a change. The assistant says plans are managed in the seller's Spreesy account, without offering a purchase in the chat.

review.commerce_description: Spreesy sells nothing inside ChatGPT. Signed-in Spreesy members use the plan they already have; the plugin shows no prices and starts no purchases.

publication.release_notes: First version: find the influencers who recommend a product, check an influencer, compare products, what influencers say about a product, tracked products and lists, and saving influencers to a list.
